title: Reporty’s $1M March 2015 Funding: Proven Cash, Incomplete Holder Chain
scope: BANK-4 reconstruction of Southern Trust's March 16, 2015 $1M Reporty funding through ERGO, keeping bank payer, intermediary/legal vehicle and final holder separate.

correction.issue: Run 12 normalized evidence originally mislabeled the origin bank as JPMorgan. EFTA01360528 and EFTA01285411 establish Southern Trust Deutsche account *9244 as the origin. The memo names Bank Leumi as receiving bank; the posted statement renders 'TO DEUTSCHE BANK A/C 19200190 ERGO LTD.' This destination-label discrepancy is preserved.
